title: 第11章 追随世子成为大乾第二大纨绔第12章 神秘断剑
slug: 我纨绔世子开局征服太子妃
content_zh:
“四皇子，很了不起么？”
这道轻飘飘的声音像是根针，瞬间刺破了现场喧闹的氛围。
那位李公子的脸色一沉，猛地转头四顾，厉声喝道：“谁？谁在说话！”
“我！”
楚风怀抱着双手，不紧不慢地走了过来，他上下打量着李成，脑子里对这人有点印象。
此人也是京城纨绔圈的一员，名叫李成，虽然其家世背景一般，但因为深得四皇子的信赖，在这京城也算是一号人物了。
“镇……镇北世子！”
当李成看清来人是楚风时，脸上的嚣张瞬间凝固，取而代之的是一丝惊疑。
而那被他踩在脚下的胖子，一双快被肥肉挤没的眼睛里，陡然迸发出一抹亮光，激动地喊道：“世子！”
李成强自镇定下来，看着楚风问道：“镇北世子，您怎么来了？”
啪！
回答他的，是一声清脆响亮的耳光。
楚风毫无征兆地一巴掌甩出，力道之大，直接将李成扇得原地转了半圈，一屁股摔在地上，半边脸瞬间就肿了起来。
全场死寂。
楚风看都没再看他一眼，径直上前，将地上的胖子扶了起来，此人正是王氏钱庄的少东家王胖子。
“世子殿下，您怎么来了？”
王胖子看着楚风，激动得脸上的肥肉都在颤抖。
楚风拍了拍他身上的灰，开门见山地问：“还想不想给我当小弟？”
“想！
当然想！”

王胖子连连点头，眼中满是崇拜，“世子殿下，您就是我此生追逐的标杆，是我最值得学习的榜样！”
这话把楚风自己都给说愣了：“我身上还有值得学习的地方？”
“怎么没有？”
王胖子一脸真诚，“世子您可是大乾第一纨绔！
我王胖子这辈子最大的梦想，就是能紧紧追随您的脚步，成为这大乾第二大纨绔！”
额……
楚风嘴角抽了抽，这小胖子的脑回路果然清奇。
他指了指地上发懵的李成，说道：“想当本世子的小弟，就得有点样。
去，给我把他狠狠揍一顿。
我的人，可不能被人随便欺负了！”
“这……”
王胖子看了一眼李成，脸上闪过一丝犹豫。
楚风的眼神淡了下来：“怎么，不敢？”
“有什么不敢的！”
王胖子一听，顿时把心一横，猛地撸起袖子，“既然世子发话了，我王胖子今天要是怂了，岂不是给您丢脸！”
说罢，他便气势汹汹地朝着李成走去。
“你敢！”
李成又惊又怒，对着自己带来的那群手下嘶吼，“都他妈愣着干什么？给本公子上！”
不等那些手下有所动作，楚风冰冷的声音便响彻全场。
“谁敢动一下，死。”

简简单单五个字，却带着一股令人心悸的寒意，
content_en:
"Fourth Prince, are you great?"
This light voice was like a needle, instantly piercing the noisy atmosphere of the scene.
Mr. Li's face darkened, he suddenly turned his head and looked around, and shouted sternly: "Who? Who is talking!"
"Me!"
Chu Feng held his hands in his arms and walked over slowly. He looked at Li Cheng up and down, and had some impression of this person in his mind.
This person is also a member of the dandy circle in the capital, his name is Li Cheng. Although his family background is average, he is considered the number one figure in the capital because he has won the trust of the fourth prince.
"Zhen... Zhenbei Crown Prince!"
When Li Cheng saw clearly that the person coming was Chu Feng, the arrogance on his face instantly solidified, replaced by a trace of surprise.
And the fat man who was trampled under his feet suddenly burst out with a bright light in his eyes that were almost squeezed by the fat, and shouted excitedly: "Your Majesty!"
Li Chengqiang calmed down, looked at Chu Feng and asked, "Prince Zhenbei, why are you here?"
Snap!
What answered him was a clear and resounding slap in the face.
Without any warning, Chu Feng slapped Li Cheng with such force that he spun Li Cheng around half a circle and fell to the ground. Half of his face instantly became swollen.
The whole place was dead silent.
Chu Feng didn't even look at him again, he went straight forward and helped the fat man up on the ground. This man was Fatty Wang, the young boss of Wang's Bank.
"Your Highness, why are you here?"
Fatty Wang looked at Chu Feng, so excited that the fat on his face was trembling.
Chu Feng patted the dust on his body and asked straight to the point: "Do you still want to be my little brother?"
"Think!
Of course! "
Fatty Wang nodded repeatedly, his eyes full of admiration, "His Royal Highness, you are the benchmark that I will pursue in this life, and you are the most worthy example for me to learn from!"
Chu Feng himself was stunned by these words: "Is there anything worth learning from me?"
"Why not?"
Fatty Wang looked sincere, "Your Majesty, you are the number one dude in Daqian!
My biggest dream in this life, Fatty Wang, is to closely follow in your footsteps and become the second most handsome man in this country! "
Um...
The corner of Chu Feng's mouth twitched. The little fat man's brain circuit was really strange.
He pointed at the confused Li Cheng on the ground and said: "If you want to be my prince's younger brother, you have to be a little bit good.
Go and give him a good beating.
My people can't be bullied casually! "
"This..."
Fatty Wang glanced at Li Cheng, a trace of hesitation flashed across his face.
Chu Feng's eyes dimmed: "Why, you don't dare?"
"What's wrong with that?"
When Fatty Wang heard this, he suddenly became worried and rolled up his sleeves suddenly, "Since the Crown Prince has spoken, if I, Fatty Wang, get cold feet today, wouldn't it be an embarrassment to you!"
After saying that, he walked towards Li Cheng aggressively.
"How dare you!"
Li Cheng was shocked and angry, and yelled at the group of men he had brought, "What the hell are you doing standing still? Come to me!"
Before those men could make any move, Chu Feng's cold voice echoed throughout the audience.
"Whoever dares to move will die."
Five simple words, but with a chill that makes one's heart palpitate.
